items: `aria-label` supplies a name to assistive technology. It should explain the same purpose as the visible control or graphic.
`tabindex="-1"` allows programmatic or link-related focus while leaving the element out of the normal Tab sequence.

blocks.text: The first link takes the reader to the main region. tabindex=-1 lets that region receive focus without joining the normal Tab order.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The link target id must exist. Test that focus and scrolling both move as intended.
